paragraphs.text: The South Sea is the sea south of Almaaz .

The South Sea lies south of Almaaz , bordering Sarraza , Sumifa and Yavimaya . It connects to the Sea of Laments in the northeast, the Shielded Sea in the east, and the Lat-Nam Straits and Ilesemare Sea in the west.

The South Sea bordered the southwestern part of Terisiare before that continent was split into smaller islands. During the Brothers' War , the sea ran along the south shores of the Halquina Mountains , past the Great Desert and Zegon to the mouth of the Mardun river. During the Dark Age , the South Sea followed the coast from Almaaz to the mouth of the Yavimaya river, and during the Ice Age , it ran from Yavimaya to the now land-locked Lat-Nam .
